final_resume.summary: Computer Science graduate (B.Tech, 2025) seeking a Software Development Engineer II role. Proficient in full-stack development with Java, Spring Boot, and React; demonstrated ability to design scalable REST APIs, write comprehensive test suites, and containerise applications.

projects.name: PaySplit - Group Expense Settlement
projects.description: Built a Spring Boot REST API and React TypeScript frontend to split shared expenses. Integrated Razorpay test-mode payments with webhooks for created, captured and refunded states. Wrote 40 JUnit tests and containerised the app with Docker.

projects.name: Campus Library Reservations
projects.description: Java and Spring Boot service with a MySQL schema for booking study rooms; piloted for 2 weeks with 120 students and removed double bookings.

projects.name: Order Tracker Dashboard
projects.description: Developed a React and TypeScript single-page application consuming a REST API to display real-time order status updates. Deployed locally using Docker Compose for reproducible development and testing environments.

profile_improvement_tips: Gain hands-on experience with distributed systems concepts (e.g., build a multi-service architecture, study eventual consistency, implement caching layers) and document this in a portfolio project.
Study and apply design patterns (Singleton, Factory, Observer, Strategy) explicitly in your code; refactor existing projects to showcase pattern usage in project descriptions.
Participate in or lead code reviews in open-source projects or team settings; highlight this experience in future roles to demonstrate code quality ownership.
Deepen algorithmic problem-solving skills by solving 50+ LeetCode/HackerRank problems and mentioning relevant optimisations (e.g., time/space complexity improvements) in project descriptions.
final_resume.growth_note: You are a strong fresher with solid full-stack fundamentals, but the SDE II role requires 3+ years of professional experience and 2+ years of systems design expertise. Your projects demonstrate REST API design and testing discipline, but lack evidence of distributed systems, algorithms, design patterns, and code review leadership. Recommend gaining 2-3 years of professional experience at a product company, then revisiting this level.
